$comment: Hand-authored metadata for the EBU3B (CSE Building) indoor layout. Combined with trace.json by scripts/build-indoor.ts. Pixel coordinates refer to the 1000x773 CSE FloorMaps images listed in sources.
name: Computer Science and Engineering Building
provenance: Traced from the UC San Diego CSE department's public floor maps (all five levels). Room positions and shapes follow those diagrams; they are not surveyed, and the plans give no scale or floor heights.

transform.note: Same transform for every floor: the five images share one pixel frame (compass rose, sculpture, and street labels sit on identical pixels, within about 1 px, on every level).

coordinateSystem.description: 1 unit = 10 pixels of the 1000x773 CSE floor-map images. The maps have no scale bar, so units are not meters.
coordinateSystem.northNote: Approximate, measured from the compass rose printed on each map: the S-to-N letters give 28.0 degrees and W-to-E give 31.0 degrees clockwise from page-up.

storyHeightNote: Placeholder chosen for legibility. The sources contain no elevations or floor heights.

sources.title: FloorMaps | Computer Science
sources.publisher: UC San Diego Computer Science and Engineering Department
sources.revision: The page shows no publication or update date.
notes: Index page listing the five floor-map images (alt text Basement, Level 1-4).

sources.title: Building EBU3B, Computer Science and Engineering Department (CSE): Basement
sources.publisher: UC San Diego Computer Science and Engineering Department
sources.orientation: Compass rose; north is about 29.5 degrees clockwise from page-up.
sources.revision: No date on the image. The meaning of the filename prefix '260909' is unknown.
notes: Room colors follow the legend: offices, conference/seminar rooms, labs/other.
B210 is labeled 'CSE Data Center', consistent with the CSE 2026 Renovation page describing a new basement server room completed in October 2025.
There is no room B220 on this map.
A large shaded region labeled 'Warren College' adjoins the building to the southwest; no rooms are drawn in it.

sources.title: Building EBU3B, Computer Science and Engineering Department (CSE): Level 1
sources.publisher: UC San Diego Computer Science and Engineering Department
sources.orientation: Compass rose; north is about 29.5 degrees clockwise from page-up.
sources.revision: No date on the image. The '_0' suffix suggests the file was replaced at least once.
notes: Only the east (12xx) wing is detailed. The west wing is a shaded region labeled 'Warren College' with no rooms.
Several offices have pale fills and small labels; their outlines are convex hulls of the traced fill and are approximate.
Doors 1-4 are marked by text labels only; the exact door positions are not drawn.
The CSE 2026 Renovation page says the first-floor east wing is being repositioned ('Coming in Spring 2026'), so this level may change.

notDetailed.B: Shown shaded and labeled 'Warren College', with no rooms. Its shape resembles the west wing drawn in detail on Levels 2-4, so it is drawn as part of the floor, but its contents are unknown.

geo.note: Fitted to the campus-map footprint (Level 2 outline, overlap 0.83): about 1.12 m per unit. The fit puts north about 50 degrees from page-up, not the 29.5 degrees of the maps' compass rose, so the rose looks inaccurate.

knownUnmapped.reason: Listed in registrar schedules, but the CSE Level 1 map details only the east (12xx) wing. The west wing is shaded with no rooms, so this room's position is not established.

notes: Room numbers were read from the maps by a person; segmentation only suggested room outlines (see docs/indoor-geometry.md).
Floor heights, slab thicknesses, and exterior appearance are not established by any source.
The registrar code is EBU3B; the department calls the building 'CSE Building'. Schedules use EBU3B, which matches the map title 'BUILDING EBU3B'.
